leakage_audit_register.why_it_leaks: Patients who died during the hospital stay (Code 11: Expired) or were discharged to hospice care (Codes 13, 14, 19, 20, 21) cannot logically be readmitted. Including them confounds readmission risk with in-hospital mortality, creating severe survivorship bias and distorting clinical decision thresholds.
leakage_audit_register.decision: Filter out all encounters with discharge disposition codes 11, 13, 14, 19, 20, 21.
leakage_audit_register.action_taken: Excluded 2,284 terminal/hospice encounters prior to any model training or evaluation.

leakage_audit_register.why_it_leaks: The 101,766 encounters represent 71,518 unique patients. A naive random train/test split would place early encounters of a patient into the training set and later encounters of the same patient into the test set. The model would memorize patient-level chronic patterns rather than learning generalizable risk factors, causing overly optimistic test metrics.
leakage_audit_register.decision: Deduplicate by keeping each patient's primary (first) encounter (Strack et al., 2014 benchmark) and strictly enforce patient-level grouping so no patient appears in multiple splits.
leakage_audit_register.action_taken: Kept primary encounters (1 per unique patient) and verified zero overlap across train/val/test.

leakage_audit_register.why_it_leaks: Arbitrary database primary key that may correlate with hospital admission batch dates or temporal ordering not available at prediction time.
leakage_audit_register.decision: Remove encounter_id from all feature sets.
leakage_audit_register.action_taken: Encounter ID is completely dropped from training and inference feature matrices.

leakage_audit_register.why_it_leaks: Computing medians, means, or frequency encodings across the full dataset before splitting leaks test set distributional statistics into training parameters.
leakage_audit_register.decision: Fit preprocessing transformers strictly on X_train only; transform X_val and X_test.
leakage_audit_register.action_taken: Wrapped in a strict Scikit-learn Pipeline / ColumnTransformer evaluated via held-out split.

leakage_audit_register.why_it_leaks: Features collected after discharge (such as post-discharge prescription fills or follow-up calls) cannot exist at the discharge prediction moment.
leakage_audit_register.decision: Constrain all engineered features strictly to observations documented on or before discharge.
leakage_audit_register.action_taken: Only pre-discharge utilization, inpatient labs, stay duration, and discharge medications are used.
